description_text:
Photorealistic, high-quality and accurate 3D model of 2027 Mercedes-Benz GLE with high detailed interior, openable hood and trunk. 
Main features:

  - Originally created with 3ds Max 2020 and rendered with Corona 12

  - Three MAX files with Corona, V-Ray and Standard 3ds Max materials. V-Ray scene, lighting and materials are similar to native Corona file

  - MAX, BLEND, C4D, MB, FBX and OBJ formats include two different file structures: default and detached, saved as separate files. Default file structure has objects being merged to larger instances (like body, doors, wheels, lights) and multi-materials assigned. Detached file structure offers more separate objects (up to 150-200 per model) and a single material per object assigned

  - Subdivision modifier is available in history for MAX, MB, C4D and BLEND files. You can get access to original non-smoothed mesh by deactivating the Subdivision modifier

  - Doors, trunk, hood, charging and fuel caps can be opened

  - Unit system is set to metric (millimeters). Real-world scale

  - All textures and materials are included and assigned

  - 31 textures, which vary in resolution from 33x796px to 8192x8192px

Special notes:
  - BLEND file has textures embedded. To unpack go to File -> External Resources -> Unpack Resources
Polycounts:MAX, MB, C4D, BLEND formats (one file for each format included with Subdiv iteration 1 applied to all objects): no Subdiv: 628,591 faces and 701,594 vertices Subdiv iteration 1: 2,510,972 faces and 2,656,246 vertices Subdiv iteration 2: 10,043,888 faces and 10,330,312 vertices 
FBX, OBJ formats (3 files included for each format): low: 628,591 faces and 701,594 vertices medium: 2,510,972 faces and 2,656,246 vertices high: 10,043,888 faces and 10,330,312 vertices 
3DS format (3 files included): low: 1,257,182 faces and 701,594 vertices medium: 5,021,944 faces and 2,656,246 vertices high: 20,087,776 faces and 10,330,312 vertices

description_text:
High detailed model created by SQUIR team.
Ready to render at 3dsmax with VRAY 3 and also Corona 2
Two rendering studios are included for VRAY3 and Corona2, with all lightning, materials, background setups
3dsmax 2010 format is also included, but without lightning/rendering studio setups and with standard materials only.
Other than 3dsmax files (3ds,fbx,lwo,c4d,obj) include only standard materials without advanced shadders or background setup.
3dsmax format is editable, with uncollapsed smoothing modifier. Maya format is editable with uncollapsed smoothing modifier.All other formats are exported as a hipoly only!
The lowest available meshsmooth level for 3dsmax and Maya formats is shown at the wire view, next to the hipoly wire view.
For this product there's 3 different 3dsmax files included.Set is uncollapsed, it's a file where you can make changes at the model. Hipoly is collapsed to hipoly with all the modifiers history cleaned to make it trouble free  while using at other programsStudio is the file with all rendering setups that we used to make the previews renderings.
Because different computers have different disks topology, it might be necessary to change the textures patches on the destination computer.
Thank you for buying SQUIR models

description_text:
This asset is a volumetric model of a Engine TEN-K   in Gaussian Splatting PLY format. The TEN-K is an inline-4 engine with a displacement of 2,100 cc—specs that might even lead one to underestimate it compared to similar engines found on the road today. However, Boreham has prioritized purity and character above all else; consequently, the engine is naturally aspirated, eschewing the easy tricks for boosting power common today—namely forced induction or electrification. This naturally aspirated 2.1-liter engine is capable of producing a maximum output of 330 hp and revving up to 10,000 rpm, thereby offering the driver a pure race-car-style driving experience.
Model Specifications:Format: PLY 3DGS Standard | Gaussians: ∼3M | Size: ∼48 MB | Clean, no floaters.
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a next-generation Radiance Field. Unlike a traditional mesh, the scene is composed of anisotropic Gaussians with Spherical Harmonics. It allows real-world captures with reflections and transparencies and instant visualization. It delivers realistic, detailed scenes with fast rendering, which is why it is used in architecture, video games, virtual reality, simulation, and real-world environment reconstruction.
EXTRA COMPATIBILITY: V-Ray (in 3ds Max / other DCCs): Starting from recent versions like V-Ray 7, it natively supports loading and rendering Gaussian Splat files integrated with ray tracing. SuperSplat, PlayCanvas, Unity, Unreal Engine, SplatViz, Three.js, Blender Addon, Babylon.js , among others.
For a quick preview, go to https://sandbox.babylonjs.com/

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the MINI John Cooper Works Countryman (interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 600000

  - 
Vertices: 560000

  - 
Geometry: Quads

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
Cyberpunk 2080 Quantum V12 Hypercar - Technical Specifications:
* Geometry: Clean Polygonal Mesh (Quads and Tris)Master Studio EditionOverview:A flagship-grade, next-generation endurance hypercar concept engineered with an exposed mid-mounted twin-turbocharged V12 quantum propulsion powertrain. Designed specifically for AAA game development, cinematic VFX production, Unreal Engine 5 virtual production, and high-end automotive commercial visualization.
Key Features and Design Highlights:

  - Exposed Mid-Mounted V12 Twin-Turbo Engine: Detailed cast-aluminum cylinder block, 24K gold cylinder heads, 12 high-voltage ignition cables, twin chrome turbochargers with burnt-titanium turbine housings, intercooler boost plumbing, and a glowing quantum plasma energy core visible beneath a glass louvered engine cover.

  - Sculpted Aerodynamic Widebody: Liquid Midnight Pearl Blue bodywork accented with Obsidian gloss black panels, a 24K Solar Gold center racing spine, and functional forged carbon fender extraction louvers.

  - Multi-Tier Ground Effect Aerodynamics: Low-slung front carbon splitter with dual-deck gold winglets, massive side intercooler air intakes, LMP1-style central fin, active swan-neck GT rear carbon wing with gold endplates, and a 6-strake venturi ground-effect diffuser.

  - Tri-Beam Matrix Laser Headlights & Horizon Taillight: High-intensity ice-white projector laser modules with sweeping amber aerodynamic DRL blades and a continuous full-width cyber horizon LED rear light bar.

  - Deep-Dish 5-Spoke Forged Rims: Concave directional star wheels with Solar Gold rim lips, massive 10-piston gold Brembo brake calipers, cross-drilled carbon-ceramic rotors, and low-profile Pirelli motorsport tires.

  - Luxury Race Cockpit: Tubular chrome safety roll cage, crimson leather and charcoal Alcantara bucket seats with 5-point gold racing harnesses, carbon-fiber F1 steering yoke, and a futuristic OLED digital telemetry HUD display.

  - Quad Burnt-Titanium Exhausts: Four performance exhaust outlets with quantum plasma afterburner thrust cones.

Included 3D File Formats:

  - Blender (.blend) - Native project file with master Principled BSDF PBR material shaders and studio lighting.

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx) - Clean hierarchy and correct pivot points, verified for Unreal Engine 5 and Unity.

  - glTF / GLB (.glb) - Optimized real-time format ready for WebGL, Three.js, and Mobile AR.

  - Wavefront OBJ (.obj + .mtl) - Universally compatible with 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, and Blender.

  - Polygon Count: 9,150

  - Vertex Count: 9,840

  - Mesh Components: 118 logically organized and named objects

  - Materials: 18 PBR Principled BSDF Materials

  - Scale: 1:1 Metric Real-World Scale (Length: 4.88m, Width: 2.25m, Height: 1.16m)

  - Render Engines: Cycles, EEVEE, Unreal Engine Lumen/Nanite, Unity HDRP/URP

  - Dependencies: 100% self-contained, no external plugins or scripts required.

description_text:
Cyberpunk 2080 Phantom RS Hypercar - Heritage EditionOverview:A premium next-generation endurance hypercar concept featuring a classic multi-color motorsport heritage livery. Perfectly optimized for AAA video games, cinematic VFX rendering, sci-fi world-building, and high-end automotive visualization.
Key Features & Design:

  - Classic Heritage Livery: High-gloss Heritage Sky Blue metallic pearl body, Solar Tangerine Orange racing center stripe, and Alpine White aerodynamic pinstripes.

  - Advanced Lighting: X-Wing Quad Laser matrix headlights with ice-white projectors and amber aerodynamic DRL accent blades.

  - Aerodynamic Styling: F1-style pointed keel nose cone, central carbon heat extractors, and functional shark-gill hood louvers.

  - Racing Wheel System: 24K gold and carbon-fiber turbofan aero-disc wheels with Solar Tangerine 8-piston Brembo calipers and cross-drilled carbon-ceramic brake rotors.

  - Detailed Luxury Interior: High-back bucket seats in saddle cognac leather and charcoal Alcantara, 4-point gold safety harnesses, F1 carbon fiber steering yoke, and digital cockpit telemetry screens.

  - Aerodynamic Body: Dihedral butterfly doors with clear lower glass viewports, carbon fiber aero mirrors, swan-neck GT rear wing, and rear venturi diffuser with triple central exhaust thrust nozzles.

Included File Formats:

  - Blender (.blend) - Native format with complete Principled BSDF PBR material shaders.

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx) - Clean hierarchy and pivots, ready for Unreal Engine 5 and Unity.

  - glTF / GLB (.glb) - Compact real-time format ready for WebGL, Three.js, and AR.

  - Wavefront OBJ (.obj + .mtl) - Universal format compatible with 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, etc.

Technical Specifications:

  - Geometry: Polygon Mesh (Clean topology, Quads/Tris)

  - Polygon Count: 8,273

  - Vertex Count: 8,822

  - Triangle Count: 17,148

  - Mesh Objects: 134 organized and logically named components

  - Materials: 19 PBR Principled BSDF Materials

  - Scale: 1:1 Metric Scale (Meters)

  - Dimensions: 4.85m (L) x 2.20m (W) x 1.15m (H)

  - Compatibility: EEVEE, Cycles, Unreal Engine, Unity

  - Plugins: None required (100% self-contained)

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Porsche 930 Turbo (interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 125000

  - 
Vertices: 130000

  - 
Geometry: Quads

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Nissan Silvia S15, meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 270000

  - 
Vertices: 275000

  - 
Geometry: Quads

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Nissan 350Z, meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 450000

  - 
Vertices: 430000

  - 
Geometry: Quads

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
This is the Cheap Creator Version of the model, equipped with 4K shared textures and shared PBR materials. It contains the raw, clean base mesh with all modifiers left unapplied, leaving a highly efficient project file totaling just 108k polygons while giving you 100% geometric control over the core structure.
Note the car comes with the metallic blue paint, very last images after UV maps shows the 108k poly mesh render with weighted normals to smooth out the faceted geometry due to low poly count, rest renders are at subd1)
Key Product Features
Blender Users (Plug & Play): For Blender users, this file works completely fine right out of the box with all modifiers left fully live. You retain absolute control to tweak the mesh density, thickness, and layout natively.
GLB, FBX, OBJ Downloaders (Don't Panic!): If you import this into other software, it will look like a half-finished, incomplete car. Do not panic! Because modifiers are unapplied, you simply need to mirror almost all parts (except a few non-symmetrical assets), apply Subdivision Surface, use Weighted Normals, and add a Solidify modifier wherever you prefer thickness.Smart Hexagon Grills (Procedural Setup): To save massive amounts of polygon data, the mesh grills are built using a 2-dimensional array modifier. The physical geometry is just a single tiny hexagon tucked into a corner. If you want thickness in the grill mesh, simply add a Solidify + Bevel modifier setup to that array asset.
100% PBR Workflow &  quad mesh  ,completely separate, modular objects  per individual part.
Alternative Versions Available On My Profile
Main Version: The standard full-detail model but some modifiers are applied, and no other format problems.
Fully Rigged Version: The ultimate animation edition set up exclusively for Blender, featuring dynamic suspension, steering, sliding window glass, moving panels, custom bone sliders, and independent light switches.
Plug and play: Buy this version for guaranteed cross-platform compatibility out of the box. It features fully optimized, merged objects and materials tailored to marketplace regulations for flawless conversion.
No interior/engine bay Options: Individual structural variations available with No Interior (Engine Only), No Engine Bay (Interior Only), or Exterior Shell Only (Both Removed).  
Need a custom car, specific modifications, or a professional animation, You can hire me as a freelancer! Feel free to email me.

description_text:
Festive Holiday Convertible Car 3D Model
DescriptionThis highly detailed 3D model features a cheerful, festive compact convertible car built for holiday cruising, finished in a smooth matte red paint job accented by a bold green racing stripe with crisp white borders running down the center. description_text:
Photorealistic, high-quality and accurate 3D model of 2027 Skoda Peaq Sportline with high detailed interior and openable trunk. 
Main features:

  - Originally created with 3ds Max 2020 and rendered with Corona 12

  - Three MAX files with Corona, V-Ray and Standard 3ds Max materials. V-Ray scene, lighting and materials are similar to native Corona file

  - MAX, BLEND, C4D, MB, FBX and OBJ formats include two different file structures: default and detached, saved as separate files. Default file structure has objects being merged to larger instances (like body, doors, wheels, lights) and multi-materials assigned. Detached file structure offers more separate objects (up to 150-200 per model) and a single material per object assigned

  - Subdivision modifier is available in history for MAX, MB, C4D and BLEND files. You can get access to original non-smoothed mesh by deactivating the Subdivision modifier

  - Doors and trunk can be opened

  - Unit system is set to metric (millimeters). Real-world scale

  - All textures and materials are included and assigned

  - 28 textures, which vary in resolution from 33x796px to 8192x8192px

Special notes:
  - BLEND file has textures embedded. To unpack go to File -> External Resources -> Unpack Resources

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Nissan Silvia S13 (basic interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Basic Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 550000

  - 
Vertices: 450000

  - 
Geometry: Quads,  Tris

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
This is the No Interior and No Engine Bay Version of the model, equipped with 4K shared textures and shared PBR materials. 
Note the car comes with the metallic blue paint, I have used glossy orange in later images to show the reflections, although its very easy to change the color if you want.
Key Product Features (Interior & Engine Excluded)
For Users who dont want the engine bay and interior, both have been removed for their interests so they are not overcharged by buying everything. 
Exterior Focused: Perfect for background traffic, massive environment scenes, architectural visualization, or fast-paced racing shots where only the car's exterior shell is visible.
100% PBR WorkflowModular Setup: Features completely separate, modular exterior objects, allowing easy, independent tweaks to single parts.
Perfect Topology: 100% quad mesh layout for flawless reflections.
Alternative Versions Available On My Profile(Check out my profile page to pick the exact configuration that fits your workflow and budget!)
Main Version: The standard full-detail model containing the completely separate, modular objects with both the full cabin interior and the highly detailed engine bay included.
Fully Rigged Version: The ultimate animation edition set up exclusively for Blender, featuring dynamic suspension, steering, sliding window glass, moving panels, custom bone sliders, and independent light switches.
Plug and play Version: Buy this version for guaranteed cross-platform compatibility out of the box. It features fully optimized, merged objects and materials tailored for flawless conversion. (Note: Other versions have a very rare chance that one or two textures may need to be manually attached in .glb, .fbx, or .obj files—the Plug and Play version completely eliminates this).
Cheap Creator Version: A budget-friendly option with just 120k polygons and all modifiers unapplied for full geometric control (includes interior and engine bay).
Only Engine bay/interior Versions: individual versions available with Only Interior Included (No Engine Bay) or Only Engine Bay Included (No Interior).
Freelance & Custom Work
Need a custom car, specific modifications, or a professional animation for your project? You can hire me as a freelancer! Feel free to email me.

3D model for printing
I present a device designed for spearfishermen. I modeled and field-tested it, using CAD software to calculate hydrodynamic flow characteristics.The valve is easy to clear and prevents water from entering the snorkel thanks to a special design (a water trap)—a feature that is particularly important in cold water. Small openings at the bottom of the valve prevent foreign particles or debris from getting inside.It is designed for snorkels with an outer diameter of 25 mm, fitting snugly and securely. description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Volkswagen Golf 8.5 R, meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 330000

  - 
Vertices: 188000

  - 
Geometry: Tris

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Mercedes-Benz C63 S AMG (interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 1330000

  - 
Vertices: 13350000

  - 
Geometry: Quads

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

Note the car comes with the metallic blue paint, i have used glossy orange in later images to show the reflections, although its very easy to change the color if you want.

Perfect Topology: 100% quad mesh layout for flawless reflections.
Alternative Versions Available On My Profile(Check out my profile page to pick the exact configuration that fits your workflow and budget!)
Main Version: The standard full-detail model containing the completely separate, modular objects with both the full cabin interior and the highly detailed engine bay included.
Fully Rigged Version: The ultimate animation edition set up exclusively for Blender, featuring dynamic suspension, steering, sliding window glass, moving panels, custom bone sliders, and independent light switches.
Plug and Play Version: Buy this version for guaranteed cross-platform compatibility out of the box. It features independent textures, merged objects and materials tailored to marketplace regulations for flawless conversion. description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Xiaomi SU7 (basic interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Basic Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 250000

  - 
Vertices: 133000

  - 
Geometry: Quads, Tris

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Advanced Rigging Features (Blender Only)
This rig is built and optimized exclusively for Blender. Functionality in other 3D software is not guaranteed.
Custom Property Sliders: Every single rigged panel and window bone comes equipped with a bone custom property slider for incredibly precise animation adjustments.Independent 
Panel Animation: The doors, front storage (frunk), and engine cover can all be moved completely independently.
Synchronized Steering: The steering wheel rotates automatically in sync with the front steering wheels.
Independent Windows: Left and right door glass slides down completely independently.
Advanced Physics Rig: Wheels, working suspension geometry, and a dedicated drift controller are fully set up for dynamic driving animations.
Smart Lighting Setup: The model features an empty cube object over the headlights named Light_Controls. Inside its object properties, you will find independent on/off toggle switches for the indicators, front/rear Daytime Running Lights (DRLs), headlight projector, and headlight turn signals.
Key Product Features
High Detail & Careful Optimization: A highly detailed asset optimized through extremely careful geometry layout, shared materials, and 4K shared textures.
Full Interior & Details: Includes a complete cabin, detailed engine bay, and front storage (frunk).
Perfect Topology: Every detail and curve is modeled with a clean, 100% quad mesh.
Highly Optimizable: Lots of headroom for optimization. You can easily delete heavy geometry you don't need (like individual pipes in the engine bay) to fit your project’s budget.
Alternative Versions Available On My Profile

Main Version: The un-rigged version of this exact car, featuring completely separate, modular objects utilizing the same 4K shared textures for easy, independent tweaks.
Plug and Play Version: Buy this version for guaranteed cross-platform compatibility out of the box. It features fully optimized, merged objects and materials tailored to marketplace regulations for flawless conversion. (Note: Other versions have a very rare chance that one or two textures may need to be manually attached in .glb, .fbx, or .obj files—the Plug and Play version completely eliminates this).
Cheaper Creator Version: A budget-friendly option with just 120k polygons and all modifiers unapplied for full geometric control.
Cheaper Performance Versions: Affordable variations with the interior and engine bay entirely excluded.

description_text:
Fourteen complete sports setups in one pack - every one a finished, self-contained set rather than a loose prop. Built at real-world scale for games, VR, architectural visualisation and motion graphics, and supplied both as one combined scene and as fourteen separate files you can drop in individually.
WHAT IS IN THE PACKBasketball Hoop - backboard, rim, net and post, 5320 trisArcade Hoops Machine - twin hoops, ball ramp, scoreboard and cabinet, 45148 trisBatting Cage - netted cage, home plate, tee, bat and helmet, 20056 trisPitching Machine - hopper, wheels, tripod and control panel, 50640 trisBowling Lane - full 23.6 m lane with pins, ball return and approach, 22096 trisBoxing Ring and Gloves - ring, ropes, corner posts and two glove pairs, 7352 trisDartboard and Darts - board, wall backing and darts, 2996 trisGolf Bag and Clubs - bag, clubs, balls and tee, 7176 trisMini Golf Hole - green, windmill obstacle, cup, flag and putter, 4584 trisSoccer Goal and Balls - goal with net and three balls, 7296 trisTable Tennis Set - table, net, paddles and balls, 5140 trisTennis Rackets and Balls - rackets with strung faces and balls, 7032 trisTennis Ball Machine - hopper full of balls, wheels and panel, 32588 trisHockey Net Sticks and Pucks - net, sticks and pucks, 4880 tris
PLEASE READ - TEXTURESThese models are UNTEXTURED. All 173 materials are flat colour with metallic and roughness values only - there are no image maps of any kind. That is a deliberate clean stylised look and it keeps the pack extremely light, which is why it suits mobile and standalone VR.Every single mesh IS fully UV mapped - zero primitives are missing UVs - so if you want textures you can paint or bake straight onto them with no unwrapping work.
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION222304 triangles and 253875 vertices across the whole pack484 objects, 173 materialsIndividual items range from 2996 triangles for the dartboard to 50640 for the pitching machinePolygon mesh, triangulated, real-world scale in metresY-up on export, every item sits on the ground at z = 0Combined layout occupies 41.9 x 29.3 x 6.37 mNo rigging, no animation, no cameras and no lights
A NOTE ON THE TRIANGLE COUNTSThe 222304 figure is the count as placed. Some items reuse instanced meshes - the bowling lane for example is 5968 unique triangles that become 22096 once its ten pins are placed. The per-item numbers above are all as-placed, which is what you actually get in your scene.
FILES INCLUDEDsports_equipment_pack.glb - all 14 sets in one scene, laid out on a gridsports_equipment_pack.fbx - the same combined scenesports_equipment_pack.blend - Blender 5.1 sourcesports_pack_14_individual_glb.zip - one GLB per set, each at its own originsports_pack_14_individual_fbx.zip - one FBX per set, each at its own originsports_pack_obj.zip - OBJ and MTL of the combined scene
ENGINE NOTESImport at scale 1.0. Use the individual files when you want single props - each one is centred at its own origin and sits on the ground, so it drops straight in with no repositioning. Use the combined scene when you want the whole set at once. Nothing depends on anything else, so delete freely. Every item is a closed solid suitable for mesh colliders.

This is a premium, highly detailed 3D model of an aggressive modern Italian supercar with angular fighter jet design. Featuring sharp, sweeping aerodynamics and a mid-engine layout inspired by cutting-edge hypercars, this asset is built to look stunning in professional renders, animations, and cinematic projects.

Key Product Features (Main Version)
High Detail & Careful Optimization: A highly detailed asset optimized through extremely careful geometry layout, shared materials, and 4K shared textures.
Modular Setup: Features completely separate, modular objects, allowing easy, independent tweaks to single parts without affecting the rest of the mesh.

Perfect Topology: Every detail and curve is modeled with a clean, 100% quad mesh.Highly Optimizable: Lots of headroom for optimization. You can easily delete heavy geometry you don't need (like individual pipes in the engine bay) to fit your project’s budget.

Rigged Version: Fully rigged and ready for animation exclusively in Blender.
Cheaper Base Mesh Version: A budget-friendly option with just 120k polygons and all modifiers unapplied for full geometric control.
Cheaper Performance Versions: Affordable variations with the interior/engine bay entirely excluded.

description_text:
High-detail 3D model of a post-apocalyptic muscle car featuring a weathered bronze and black metal finish with heavy combat modifications. Designed with a horned metallic wolf skull mounted on the front grille, a giant vertebrate spine arching over the rear deck lid wrapped in heavy iron chains, pitch-black tinted windows, vented hood scoops, and wide-body fender flares. High-resolution PBR textures deliver realistic scratched bronze metal surfaces, pitted iron chain displacement, weathered bone textures, and high-gloss privacy glass refractions. Perfect for wasteland combat racers, cyberpunk games, post-apocalyptic maps, and cinematic renders.
Key Features
Wolf Skull Grille Mount: Front bumper features a horned, fanged metallic canine skull acting as a menacing ram ornament.
Spine & Chain Rear Deck: Large bone vertebrate structure arced across the rear trunk deck, secured with heavy steel chains.
Wide-Body Combat Chassis: Vented hood intake, rivet-bolted fender flares, and two-tone distressed bronze and matte black body panels.
Game & Render Ready: Fully detailed vehicle asset optimized for action-racing titles, post-apocalyptic zones, level design, and renders.

Golf Flag 2 is a high quality, photo real 3d model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects. The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max and rendered with V-Ray. Renders have no postprocessing!

Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, has real dimensions. Easy to merge into your scene.

  - Units: cm

  - The model was created with the optimal number of polygons. (The Meshsmooth modifier is assigned to the original mesh. Easy to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All the objects come with complete UVsAll textures and materials are included and mapped. (All colors can be easily modified.)

  - All objects are logically named and grouped for ease of objects selection and scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary (Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.) - just drop model into your scene.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - PBR Materials

Textures Formats:

  - (3 .png) 2048 x 2048

  - (1 .psd) 2048 x 2048

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Dodge Charger Daytona Banshee, meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 735000

  - 
Vertices: 740000

  - 
Geometry: Quads

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

High detailed model created by SQUIR team.
Ready to render at 3dsmax with VRAY 3 and also Corona 2
Two rendering studios are included for VRAY3 and Corona2, with all lightning, materials, background setups
3dsmax 2010 format is also included, but without lightning/rendering studio setups and with standard materials only.

3dsmax format is editable, with uncollapsed smoothing modifier. Maya format is editable with uncollapsed smoothing modifier.All other formats are exported as a hipoly only!
The lowest available meshsmooth level for 3dsmax and Maya formats is shown at the wire view, next to the hipoly wire view.
For this product there's 3 different 3dsmax files included.Set is uncollapsed, it's a file where you can make changes at the model. Hipoly is collapsed to hipoly with all the modifiers history cleaned to make it trouble free  while using at other programsStudio is the file with all rendering setups that we used to make the previews renderings.
Because different computers have different disks topology, it might be necessary to change the textures patches on the destination computer.
Thank you for buying SQUIR models

IDEAL FOR

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Zeekr 001 (interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 300000

  - 
Vertices: 160000

  - 
Geometry: Tris

  - 
Textures: No

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
Photorealistic, high-quality and accurate 3D model of 2027 Porsche 911 (992.2) GT3 S/C with high detailed interior. 
Main features:

  - Originally created with 3ds Max 2020 and rendered with Corona 12

  - Three MAX files with Corona, V-Ray and Standard 3ds Max materials. V-Ray scene, lighting and materials are similar to native Corona file

  - MAX, BLEND, C4D, MB, FBX and OBJ formats include two different file structures: default and detached, saved as separate files. Default file structure has objects being merged to larger instances (like body, doors, wheels, lights) and multi-materials assigned. Detached file structure offers more separate objects (up to 150-200 per model) and a single material per object assigned

  - Subdivision modifier is available in history for MAX, MB, C4D and BLEND files. You can get access to original non-smoothed mesh by deactivating the Subdivision modifier

  - Doors can be opened

  - Unit system is set to metric (millimeters). Real-world scale

  - All textures and materials are included and assigned

  - 31 textures, which vary in resolution from 64x64px to 8192x8192px

Special notes:
  - BLEND file has textures embedded. To unpack go to File -> External Resources -> Unpack Resources

description_text:
Product Overview
A detailed 3D model of a classic old-style bicycle saddle, complete with its vintage contoured leather-look seat, rear suspension springs, and seat post assembly. The model is meticulously crafted with authentic proportions and traditional styling lines, ideal for vintage bicycle restorations, product visualisation, retro design presentations, and rendering projects.
Key Design & Structural Features
The model was created using SolidWorks; the parts are properly modelled as solid components, reflecting clean vintage styling lines, realistic ergonomic shaping, dual rear suspension springs, and a distinct rail and seat post clamp mechanism.
Development & Visual Versatility
The package includes KeyShot files with all materials, lights, and cameras set up. Since the model is high-definition, it can also be used in other software—both 3D modelling and visualisation programs—such as Cinema 4D and 3ds Max, and rendered with your preferred materials in V-Ray, Corona, or other engines. It can also be imported into real-time engines and simulators such as Unreal Engine and Unity. Please note that you’ll also find *.glb files, which allow you to use the 3D models within Adobe After Effects to animate them and incorporate them into motion graphics projects.
Technical Specifications
Scale: The file is designed in 1:1 scale (millimeters/metric system)
Topology: All 3D files are generated from SolidWorks and KeyShot, so the surfaces feature clean and optimised geometry
Materials: The materials are chosen based on the object's vintage design, suitable for classic leather-textured seating, metallic springs, and steel components, fully customizable to your preferred render style
Scene Content: Includes the complete old-style bicycle saddle, rear springs, and seat post assembly. The 3D file does not include a scene with other objects.

OBJ (Universal Wavefront)

STL (High-density, error-free mesh optimized for 3D printing)
STEP / IGES (NURBS format for manufacturing and CAD cross-compatibility)
PARASOLID (*.x_t interchange format for engineering software)
KEYSHOT (Package with materials, scene, studio lighting, and cameras)

description_text:
Team Shelter 01. Football Soccer Substitute Bench Dugout. Subdivision-ready
High-quality 3D model of a sports team shelter dugout featuring a blue curved canopy and 10 red bucket seats. Perfect for soccer stadiums, football pitches, athletic complexes, sports training grounds, and outdoor arena scenes.
------------------------------ USAGE ------------------------------------

  - This model is suitable for use in PC/mobile game-development, vr/ar, advertising, design visualization, forensic presentation, etc.

  - The model is ready for display in any orientation (without holes).

--------------------------- TOPOLOGY --------------------------------

  - Model consist of 2 objects total.

  - No Ngons used, just Quads and Tris

  - Model Total:

  - 221.088 tris

  - Shelter_Roof: 6.176 vertices, 5.702 polygons

  - Shelter_Seats: 106.568 vertices, 105.404 polygons

--------------------------- MATERIALS and TD --------------------------------

  - Model use 1 texture sets total:

  - MI_TeamShelter01_Blue: 546 px/m (4K textures)

  - Average texel density 546 px/m

  - Less visible elements has less TD

------------------------ TEXTURES and UV -------------------------

  - Model is completely UVunwrapped. You can see all the textures and UV maps on the preview images

  - Non-Overlapping method was used.

  - Both Metallic/Rough and Specular/Gloss PBR workflows are available

  - Additionaly all mesh maps included (ao, curvature, id, normal_base, position, thickness, world_space_normals)

  - Additionally included textures in format Unreal Engine Packed (BaseColor, - NormalMap 8bit + dithering, OcclusionRoughMetallic)

-------------------------- DESCRIPTION ------------------------------

  - Clear topology with no any artefacts, holes, overlapping polygons and so on

  - All materials and textures are intelligently named

  - PBR materials, as you can see on the preview

  - No special plugin needed to open scene

  - Real world scale 1:1

  - Units of measurements are centimeters

Carbon Fly Rod with Reel is a three-dimensional model of a modern fly fishing rod and reel setup, designed for freshwater and saltwater angling, casting precision, and sport fishing applications.
The model features a lightweight carbon fiber rod, detailed fly reel, line guides, ergonomic grip, and realistic materials. Its high level of detail makes it suitable for close-up renders, outdoor scenes, and fishing equipment visualizations.
For fishing simulations, outdoor recreation projects, sporting goods advertising, ecommerce catalogs, hunting and fishing content, game development, animation productions, virtual reality experiences, product presentations, and recreational tourism marketing.
Carbon Fly Rod with Reel is a high quality, photo real 3d model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects. The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max and rendered with V-Ray. Renders have no postprocessing!
Hope you like it!
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, has real dimensions. Easy to merge into your scene.

  - All objects are logically named and grouped for ease of objects selection and scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary (Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.) - just drop model into your scene.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - PBR Materials

Textures Formats:

  - 8 png (4096x4096)

  - Dimensions 142,83 x 6,52 x H16,48cm

Thanks in advance!

description_text:
This is a highly detailed, production-ready base mesh of a realistic motorcycle, meticulously crafted to serve as the perfect foundation for your 3D projects. This product includes the raw, untextured 3D model only – no materials, textures, UVs, rigging, or animation are included. The model is built to real-world scale and proportions, accurately replicating the form and key details of a contemporary street motorcycle.
Key features:
• Clean Topology: Optimized polygon flow for easy subdivision, deformation, and rigging. 
• Accurate Proportions: Based on real-world measurements for realistic representation. 
• Detailed Base Mesh: Includes essential components such as frame, engine block, wheels, suspension, handlebars, seat, and basic fairings, providing a solid starting point for customization. 
• Focus on Form: Emphasis on accurate shapes and volumes, allowing for detailed sculpting and refinement. 
• Ideal for Customization: Designed to be easily modified and adapted to various motorcycle styles, from sport bikes to cruisers. 
This base mesh is perfect for:
• Game asset creation 
• High-poly sculpting and detailing 
• Concept design and visualization 
• Vehicle simulation and rendering 
This product provides a high-quality, efficient starting point for creating stunningly realistic motorcycle models. It saves valuable time and effort by providing a solid, accurate base, allowing artists to focus on the creative aspects of texturing, materials, and final detailing.
We will be happy to help you if you need any assistance with this asset.
For aditional information email us to:
reystudio3dart@gmail.com
(Any future improvement or update of this asset will be included in this purchase)

  - Three MAX files with Corona, V-Ray and Standard 3ds Max materials. V-Ray scene, lighting and materials are similar to native Corona file

description_text:
Highly detailed Rigged 3D model of the Porsche Panamera Turbo S 2022 (interior included), meticulously crafted to maintain exact real-world proportions and clean mesh/material organization. Produced by Anatolian Studios, this model is designed to be instantly ready for your renders, animations, or visualization projects without requiring any redesign, scaling, or adjustments.
Key Features:

  - 
Built to Real-World Scale: Modeled accurately in meters with exact physical proportions — no rescaling needed.

  - 
Detailed Exterior & Interior: Fully detailed body, cabin, and trim, suitable for both close-up hero shots and animation.

  - 
Clean, Organized Structure: Every body panel, wheel, light, and trim piece is a separate, logically named object, grouped under Chassis / Exterior / Glass / Interior / Lights / Wheels, with materials named to match their parts for a fast, professional workflow.

  - 
Easy-to-Edit Materials: Clean Principled BSDF setup using solid-color materials, no advanced texturing or node knowledge required.

  - 
Correct Glass Setup: Transparent and glass surfaces are properly configured and export-friendly across all included formats.

  - 
Scene Ready: Centered at origin (0,0,0) with reset transforms and a single master parent, so the entire vehicle can be moved, rotated, or scaled as one unit.

Vehicle Rig (included):
The .blend file includes a production-ready vehicle rig, no add-ons needed. 
One slider steers both front wheels and the steering wheel together; drive the car forward and all four wheels roll automatically at the correct rate. Also included: per-axle and per-wheel manual spin, independent suspension travel on all four corners, and body pitch/roll for braking dive and cornering lean. Bones are cleanly named (CTRL_Root, CTRL_Body, CTRL_Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR) with pivots centered on each axle, and the model is skinned so the skeleton carries over to the FBX and glTF files.
Documented rig guide (pdf) is included in the files.
Included File Formats:

  - 
.blend (Native Blender file — full rig with automatic steering and wheel roll, materials assigned, rendered in Cycles/Eevee)

  - 
.fbx (Widely supported format, retains geometry and material data)

  - 
.fbx (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.obj & .mtl (Universal 3D format)

  - 
.gltf / .glb (Optimized format for real-time engines, web viewing, and AR/VR)

  - 
.glb (rigged) (Same model with bones and skinning included)

  - 
.usdz / .usdc (Universal Scene Description — AR Quick Look, iOS, and USD pipelines)

Technical Specifications:

  - 
Polygons: 1865000

  - 
Vertices: 950000

  - 
Geometry: Tris

  - 
Textures:  Included where applicable — mostly solid-color materials with image textures on select parts (logos, badges, decals, etc.), provided in a neatly organized .zip archive.

  - 
Materials: Yes

  - 
UV Mapped: Mixed

  - 
Rigged: Yes (.blend, .fbx, .glb)

Please Note:

  - The rigged and un-rigged versions are supplied as separate files. The standard .fbx / .glb / .obj / .usdz files contain no skeleton and keep the full group hierarchy intact; the files marked rigged contain the bones and skinning.

  - The rig's automatic steering and wheel roll are expression-driven and run in Blender. In FBX and glTF the bones, skinning and wheel pivots are fully present and can be posed or animated, but that automation does not transfer — a limitation of the interchange formats, not of the model.

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, fan-made model created for visualization purposes and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the manufacturer. All brand names, logos, and trademarks are property of their respective owners.

description_text:
Modular Skatepark Ramp Elements Set is a set of three-dimensional models of modular skatepark ramps and obstacle elements for building custom extreme sports layouts.
The set includes multiple plywood-style skatepark ramp elements with black side panels, orange riding surfaces, metal safety railings, raised platforms, quarter pipes, halfpipe sections, bank ramps, funbox obstacles, grind rail areas, and elevated transition structures. It naturally matches search terms such as skatepark ramps, modular skate park, half pipe ramp, quarter pipe, BMX ramp, scooter park obstacles, and extreme sports equipment assets.
For skatepark visualization, urban sports environments, BMX and scooter park scenes, architectural planning, game development, animation, VFX, virtual reality, augmented reality, training simulations, and digital outdoor recreation asset libraries.
Modular Skatepark Ramp Elements Set is a high quality, photo real 3d model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects. The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max and rendered with V-Ray. Renders have no postprocessing!
Hope you like it!
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, has real dimensions. Easy to merge into your scene.

  - Units: cm

  - The model was created with the optimal number of polygons. (The Meshsmooth modifier is assigned to the original mesh. Easy to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All the objects come with complete UVsAll textures and materials are included and mapped. (All colors can be easily modified.)

  - All objects are logically named and grouped for ease of objects selection and scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessary (Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.) - just drop model into your scene.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - PBR Materials

Textures Formats:

  - 40 png (4096x4096)

  - Dimensions 16,74 x 14,89 x H2,85m

description_text:
A blue GT3 style sports coupe with a fixed rear wing and a modeled two seat cabin. The rounded front lighting and sloping roofline make it a recognizable focal vehicle for trackside scenes and automotive presentations.
KEY FEATURES

  - Blue coupe body with rounded headlamps and twin bonnet vents

  - Low front splitter and black multi spoke wheels

  - Fixed rear wing above a sloping rear deck

  - Narrow rear light bar and central twin exhaust outlets

INTERIOR DETAILSThe modeled cabin includes two sculpted bucket seats with harness openings, seat belt details, a steering wheel, dashboard, center console and interior door trim. The dashboard includes an instrument cluster and a raised central clock form; the console contains a gear selector and surrounding controls. Rear bracing is visible behind the seats.
TEXTURES AND MATERIALS

  - UV mapped vehicle geometry

  - Texture resolution: 4K (4096 x 4096)

  - PNG texture maps: Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Alpha

  - Textured materials for the supplied vehicle appearance

INCLUDED FILE FORMATS

  - Blender (.blend)

  - FBX (.fbx)

  - OBJ (.obj)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - USDZ (.usdz)

  - PNG texture set

MODEL SPECIFICATIONS

  - Vertices: 126,403

  - Polygons: 140,010

  - Triangles: 233,600

  - Geometry counts are measured before modifiers; exported totals may vary.

RECOMMENDED USESTrack paddocks, sports car showrooms, garage interiors and exterior automotive portfolios.All files are constantly updated, so once you have purchased them you have access to all improvements and updates that appear.
