description_text:
This Female Crew Neck Folded Stacked Dark Blue is a high end, photorealistic 3D model, that will help you to add realism to your project.The model is suitable for any visual production - broadcast, high-res film close-ups, advertising, games, design visualisation, forensic presentation, etc.

The model was initially created in 3Ds Max 2018, then fully textured and rendered using V-Ray.

All geometry and visual aspects of the model are optimised to give you the highest possible quality for up to 2k renders. There is no post-production used on any of the renders you see.

Features:

 -This model is accurately sized to match the real object.
    -Objects are grouped and named according to their real purpose, allowing the model to be rigged and animated smoothly.
   -Clean and optimised topology is used for maximum polygon efficiency.
    -Model is fully sub-dividable to allow Turbosmooth Iterations to increase mesh smoothness if needed.
 -All textures and materials are tailored and applied for high-quality render results.
    -All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.
   -No extra plugins are required for this model.
   -Lights and cameras are not included in the scenes.

Technical Specifications:

-Model is included in 4 file formats.
                -3ds Max V-Ray
                -3ds Max Mental ray
                -Cinema 4D R17 V-Ray
                -OBJ

    -Model consists of 26096 Faces and 26300 Vertices.
   -Model consists of quads only.
   -Model Dimensions: 31.525cm x 41.866cm x 7.641cm
 -Units in all formats: #centimeters
  -All Textures are PNG format with the following resolutions:
     - 4096 x 4096 px

Additional Notes:

This model was created for 10 hours form our Leading 3D artists to ensure you get the best quality model and save precious production time.

  - All objects are logically named and grouped for ease of objects selection and scene management.

  - No cleaning up necessary (Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.) - just drop model into your scene.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - PBR Materials

Textures Formats:

  - 12 png (8192x8192)

  - Dimensions 116,92 x 74,9 x H33,48cm

Ideal for racing simulators, urban environments, and pristine vehicle showcases, highlighting a flawless dark red aerodynamic fairing, a clean black leather seat, and a sleek tinted glass windshield.

This clean mesh layout ensures smooth integration, significantly minimizing the risk of geometry-based customer refunds or automated item suspensions on commercial 3D marketplaces like CGTrader. Textures: 4K and 8K PBR Texture Maps (Albedo, Roughness, Metalness, Normal) tuned for glossy car paint, clean tinted glass, polished metal, and treated leather.
Engine Integration: Standard asset pivot points grounded and centered. Fully compatible with Unreal Engine and Unity.
Presentation TipPlace the model resting elegantly on its kickstand in a brightly lit, pristine digital showroom floor or on a modern racing track starting line. Utilize crisp directional lighting to catch the realistic reflections on the tinted windshield glass and highlight the glossy finish of the dark red fairing, achieving a highly authentic promotional render.

description_text:
The definitive Japanese High School campus environment: 660 unique assets, 1,664 assembled meshes, and an expansive 144 x 84 m campus combining all five departments into one seamless, fully roofed, plug-and-play institutional world.
From morning arrival through the iron gates under blooming cherry blossoms, to lectures in Class 2-B, after-school band practice, late-night teacher grading in the faculty pods, volleyball matches under steel gym trusses, and lunchtime conversations on the fenced rooftop terrace — Sakura Heights Academy delivers the complete anime and manga school experience with unmatched architectural precision.
ALL FIVE SUB-PACKS INCLUDED IN ONE UNIFIED MEGA BUNDLE (660 UNIQUE ASSETS)

  - Classrooms & Core Architecture (140 assets): 3-storey school wing, 4 m facade modules, Class 2-B, 3 m wide corridors, genkan entrance with getabako shoe lockers, modular stairwells, student desks with bag hooks, 3.6 m magnetic blackboards, bento lunches, and cleaning duty carts.

  - Specialist Club Rooms & Labs (140 assets): Six furnished club rooms including the Science Lab with anatomical skeleton Ossan, Art Studio with easels and ceramics kiln, Music Room with acoustic grand piano and drum kit, Home Economics commercial kitchen, AV broadcasting studio with CRT monitors, and quiet Library reading nook with tall oak bookshelves.

  - Faculty Administration Wing (120 assets): Fully enclosed 48 m administration building with central staff room (4-desk teacher pods, hanko red stamps, grading desks), Principal's executive suite, School Infirmary with curtained recovery cots, Student Counseling office, conference room, and printing archives with Risograph duplicator.

  - Gymnasium & Sports Hall (120 assets): Complete 24 x 40 m main sports hall with 8 m clear ceiling height beneath steel trusses, tournament volleyball net, basketball hoops, digital LED scoreboard, ceremonial event stage with red velvet curtain, equipment storage cage, vaulting boxes (tobi-bako), and locker rooms.

  - Campus Grounds & Outdoor Precinct (140 assets): Heavy sliding iron main gates with brass school nameplate, arrival courtyard with full-bloom sakura and golden ginkgo trees, 1.8 m fenced school rooftop terrace, sports field with cinder running track and baseball backstop, covered bicycle parking shelter, and illuminated Japanese vending machines.

THE UNIFIED 4 M ARCHITECTURAL MODULE CONTRACTEvery building, room, and courtyard connects seamlessly on one master grid:

  - Structural Grid: Exactly 4 m throughout all wings and outdoor paving.

  - Floor-to-Floor Datum: 3.6 m (3.4 m clear ceiling + 0.2 m reinforced floor slab).

  - Corridor Datum: 3.0 m clear width throughout classrooms, specialist wing, and faculty.

  - Master Campus Footprint: 144 x 84 m (X -82...62 m, Y -24...60 m, Z -0.14...14.66 m).

  - Zero Ground Voids: Seamless connecting courtyard and breezeway paving slabs eliminate dark voids between buildings.

  - Zero Floaters: Rooftop club terrace and story props rest flush on physical structural slabs.

STREAMLINED ELEVEN-MATERIAL SYSTEMDesigned for lightweight rendering and draw-call efficiency across large scenes:

  - Five 2048x2048 PBR color atlases: M_Pack_Atlas_Classrooms, M_Pack_Atlas_Specialist, M_Pack_Atlas_Faculty, M_Pack_Atlas_Gymnasium, M_Pack_Atlas_Grounds.

  - One shared glass material: M_Glass (smooth blended transmission for all windows and cabinets).

  - Five signature dusk emissive accents: M_Emissive_Lamp, M_Emissive_Monitor, M_Emissive_Desklamp, M_Emissive_Score, M_Emissive_Vending.

PRE-TESTED EXPORT PIPELINE

  - Base-centered pivots: Center X = 0, Center Y = 0, Minimum Z = 0 on every individual model.

  - 660 individual FBX files, all independently re-imported and topology-verified.

  - 660 individual OBJ files with 660 companion MTL files and atlas texture copies.

  - 1 combined origin-correct GLB master campus assembly (119.7 MB, 1,664 nodes).

  - Clean Blender master scene with realistic dusk atmosphere, exterior sun rig, and interior lights.

DOWNLOAD CONTENTS

  - Clean Sakura_Heights_Academy.blend master scene with all 1,664 assembled meshes, camera, and lighting rig.

  - 660 individual FBX files, all re-import tested.

  - 660 OBJ files with 660 companion MTL files and 5 atlas texture copies.

  - 1 combined glTF 2.0 GLB master campus assembly.

  - 5x 2048x2048 PBR color texture atlas PNGs + 5 labeled UV layout PNGs.

  - 19 HD 1920x1080 Cycles marketing stills including campus aerials, all 5 department hero rooms, and wireframe topology proofs.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  - 660 unique assets (1,664 meshes in assembled master campus)

  - 1,548,354 triangles total (2,346 average triangles per asset — massive detail across campus)

  - 834,609 vertices, 860,783 faces / polygons

  - 11 clean materials (5 PBR atlases, 1 glass, 5 signature emissives)

  - Single active UV channel per textured model (clean atlas palette mapping)

  - Real-world metric scale on 4 m modular grid

  - Supported formats: BLEND, FBX, OBJ/MTL, GLB

Ideal for full video games (anime RPGs, school life simulators, visual novels, horror games), virtual production, VTuber streaming environments, VRChat roleplay worlds, Roblox games, and 3D animated series.

ALL FIVE SUB-PACKS INCLUDED IN ONE UNIFIED MEGA BUNDLE (660 UNIQUE ASSETS)

  - Classrooms & Core Architecture (140 assets): 3-storey school wing, 4 m facade modules, Class 2-B, 3 m wide corridors, genkan entrance with getabako shoe lockers, modular stairwells, student desks with bag hooks, 3.6 m magnetic blackboards, bento lunches, and cleaning duty carts.

  - Specialist Club Rooms & Labs (140 assets): Six furnished club rooms including the Science Lab with anatomical skeleton Ossan, Art Studio with easels and ceramics kiln, Music Room with acoustic grand piano and drum kit, Home Economics commercial kitchen, AV broadcasting studio with CRT monitors, and quiet Library reading nook with tall oak bookshelves.

  - Faculty Administration Wing (120 assets): Fully enclosed 48 m administration building with central staff room (4-desk teacher pods, hanko red stamps, grading desks), Principal's executive suite, School Infirmary with curtained recovery cots, Student Counseling office, conference room, and printing archives with Risograph duplicator.

  - Gymnasium & Sports Hall (120 assets): Complete 24 x 40 m main sports hall with 8 m clear ceiling height beneath steel trusses, tournament volleyball net, basketball hoops, digital LED scoreboard, ceremonial event stage with red velvet curtain, equipment storage cage, vaulting boxes (tobi-bako), and locker rooms.

  - Campus Grounds & Outdoor Precinct (140 assets): Heavy sliding iron main gates with brass school nameplate, arrival courtyard with full-bloom sakura and golden ginkgo trees, 1.8 m fenced school rooftop terrace, sports field with cinder running track and baseball backstop, covered bicycle parking shelter, and illuminated Japanese vending machines.

THE UNIFIED 4 M ARCHITECTURAL MODULE CONTRACTEvery building, room, and courtyard connects seamlessly on one master grid:

  - Structural Grid: Exactly 4 m throughout all wings and outdoor paving.

  - Floor-to-Floor Datum: 3.6 m (3.4 m clear ceiling + 0.2 m reinforced floor slab).

  - Corridor Datum: 3.0 m clear width throughout classrooms, specialist wing, and faculty.

  - Master Campus Footprint: 144 x 84 m (X -82...62 m, Y -24...60 m, Z -0.14...14.66 m).

  - Zero Ground Voids: Seamless connecting courtyard and breezeway paving slabs eliminate dark voids between buildings.

  - Zero Floaters: Rooftop club terrace and story props rest flush on physical structural slabs.

STREAMLINED ELEVEN-MATERIAL SYSTEMDesigned for lightweight rendering and draw-call efficiency across large scenes:

  - Five 2048x2048 PBR color atlases: M_Pack_Atlas_Classrooms, M_Pack_Atlas_Specialist, M_Pack_Atlas_Faculty, M_Pack_Atlas_Gymnasium, M_Pack_Atlas_Grounds.

  - One shared glass material: M_Glass (smooth blended transmission for all windows and cabinets).

  - Five signature dusk emissive accents: M_Emissive_Lamp, M_Emissive_Monitor, M_Emissive_Desklamp, M_Emissive_Score, M_Emissive_Vending.

PRE-TESTED EXPORT PIPELINE

  - Base-centered pivots: Center X = 0, Center Y = 0, Minimum Z = 0 on every individual model.

  - 660 individual FBX files, all independently re-imported and topology-verified.

  - 660 individual OBJ files with 660 companion MTL files and atlas texture copies.

  - 1 combined origin-correct GLB master campus assembly (119.7 MB, 1,664 nodes).

  - Clean Blender master scene with realistic dusk atmosphere, exterior sun rig, and interior lights.

DOWNLOAD CONTENTS

  - Clean Sakura_Heights_Academy.blend master scene with all 1,664 assembled meshes, camera, and lighting rig.

  - 660 individual FBX files, all re-import tested.

  - 660 OBJ files with 660 companion MTL files and 5 atlas texture copies.

  - 1 combined glTF 2.0 GLB master campus assembly.

  - 5x 2048x2048 PBR color texture atlas PNGs + 5 labeled UV layout PNGs.

  - 19 HD 1920x1080 Cycles marketing stills including campus aerials, all 5 department hero rooms, and wireframe topology proofs.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  - 660 unique assets (1,664 meshes in assembled master campus)

  - 1,548,354 triangles total (2,346 average triangles per asset — massive detail across campus)

  - 834,609 vertices, 860,783 faces / polygons

  - 11 clean materials (5 PBR atlases, 1 glass, 5 signature emissives)

  - Single active UV channel per textured model (clean atlas palette mapping)

  - Real-world metric scale on 4 m modular grid

  - Supported formats: BLEND, FBX, OBJ/MTL, GLB

Ideal for full video games (anime RPGs, school life simulators, visual novels, horror games), virtual production, VTuber streaming environments, VRChat roleplay worlds, Roblox games, and 3D animated series.

description_text:
Japanese High School Campus Grounds - Anime Rooftop, Gate & Sports Field (140 Assets)Morning arrival through the heavy sliding iron school gates as cherry blossom petals drift across the paved courtyard. 
At lunchtime, a student slips through the heavy fire door onto the school rooftop — the iconic anime rooftop setting, framed by tall chain-link safety fences, weathered concrete ventilation towers, and sweeping views across town. In the afternoon, the clatter of spiked cleats on the cinder running track, the crack of a baseball against the backstop fence, and the soft amber glow of courtyard vending machines dispensing cold canned tea complete the authentic Japanese school life experience.
Sakura Heights Grounds is Pack 5 of the Sakura Heights Japanese High School series: 140 modular, production-ready assets delivering a complete 84 x 84 m outdoor school campus precinct. Built with modular precision on the shared 4 m architectural grid, it seamlessly supports school entrance scenes, rooftop confession moments, sports club practices, and cultural festival grounds.
SIX COMPLETE CAMPUS PRECINCTS (140 UNIQUE ASSETS)

  - Main Gate, Perimeter Walls & Street Edge (24 assets): Heavy concrete entrance gate piers with brass engraved school nameplate, sliding iron vehicular gates, pedestrian swing door, perimeter concrete walls with decorative steel grilles, convex curved street safety mirrors, sidewalk curbs, street storm drain grates, and utility power poles with transformers.

  - Front Arrival, Courtyard & Landscaping (24 assets): Broad paved entrance walkway, outdoor stone and timber benches, brick planting beds, full-bloom Japanese cherry blossom (sakura) trees, golden autumn ginkgo trees, pruned topiary shrubs, outdoor drinking water fountain, and school glass bulletin notice board.

  - Sports Field, Running Track & Athletics (24 assets): Cinder running track lane curves, heavy chain-link baseball backstop cage, full-size soccer goals with mesh netting, outdoor basketball half-court hoop, groundskeeper clay line roller, chalk field marker cart, outdoor sports equipment shed, and spectator bleachers.

  - Covered Bicycle Parking & Utilities (20 assets): Corrugated metal roof bicycle parking shelter, steel wheel-lock bike racks, student commuter bicycles (classic Japanese mamachari with front basket), outdoor mop cleaning sink, municipal trash sorting recycling bins, exterior electrical power junction box, and groundskeeper wheelbarrow.

  - School Rooftop, Safety Fences & Club Terrace (20 assets): 1.8 m high chain-link rooftop security fence with barbed tension wire, locked rooftop access stairwell bulkhead, rooftop HVAC ventilation plant, maintenance exhaust ducts, vintage wind vane, wooden rooftop benches, and perimeter rainwater drainage channels.

  - Seasonal Dressing & Cultural Festival Vignettes (28 assets): Authentic Japanese vending machines with illuminated display marquees, wooden cultural festival food stall with fabric noren curtain, festive paper lantern strings, student club recruitment signboards, sports ball carts, lost umbrellas, and chalk-drawn sports tactics diagrams.

THE SHARED 4 M ARCHITECTURAL MODULE CONTRACTThis outdoor precinct is engineered to frame and connect the entire school:

  - Structural Grid: Exactly 4 m (matches Classrooms, Specialist, Faculty, and Gymnasium).

  - Precinct Dimensions: Expansive 84 x 84 m campus layout with realistic circulation.

  - Rooftop Fence Height: 1.8 m safety datum conforming to standard Japanese school architectural codes.

  - Snaps natively into the 660-asset Sakura Heights Academy master campus bundle.

ENGINE-READY THREE-MATERIAL SYSTEMThree clean materials provide lightweight performance and global lighting control:

  - M_Pack_Atlas: One single 2048x2048 PBR texture atlas covering all paving, asphalt, concrete walls, steel fences, trees, sakura foliage, sports equipment, and bikes.

  - M_Glass: Transparent vending machine glass, greenhouse panels, and exterior window glazing.

  - M_Emissive_Vending: Glowing Japanese vending machine marquees, illuminated entrance gate lanterns, and bulletin board fixtures.

PRE-TESTED EXPORT PIPELINE

  - Base-centered pivots: Center X = 0, Center Y = 0, Minimum Z = 0 on every individual model.

  - 140 individual FBX files, all independently re-imported and topology-verified.

  - 140 individual OBJ files with matched MTL files and self-contained atlas texture copy.

  - 1 combined origin-correct GLB containing the complete 240-mesh assembled campus precinct.

  - Clean Blender master scene with realistic dusk atmosphere, street lighting, and camera angles.

DOWNLOAD CONTENTS

  - Clean Sakura_Heights_Grounds.blend master scene with all 240 assembled precinct meshes, camera, and lighting rig.

  - 140 individual FBX files, all re-import tested.

  - 140 OBJ files with 140 companion MTL files and atlas texture copy.

  - 1 combined glTF 2.0 GLB master campus grounds assembly.

  - 2048x2048 PBR color texture atlas PNG + labeled UV layout PNG.

  - 14 HD 1920x1080 Cycles marketing stills including campus dusk reveal, rooftop views, sports field, and wireframe topology proofs.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  - 140 unique assets (240 meshes in assembled master grounds precinct)

  - 312,840 triangles total (2,234 average triangles per asset — rich foliage and athletic detail)

  - 167,402 vertices, 173,732 faces / polygons

  - Largest asset: Baseball_Backstop_Fence at 12,480 tris

  - Smallest asset: Chalk_Field_Cone at 32 tris

  - 3 clean materials: M_Pack_Atlas, M_Glass, M_Emissive_Vending

  - Single active UV channel per textured model (clean atlas palette mapping)

  - Real-world metric scale on 4 m modular grid

  - Supported formats: BLEND, FBX, OBJ/MTL, GLB

Ideal for anime visual novels, manga backgrounds, school romance and horror games, VRChat school worlds, VTuber streaming backdrops, Roblox school life roleplay, and stylized cinematics.

description_text:
The squeak of rubber soles on polished court floorboards, the resonant thud of a volleyball spike against steel trusses, and late afternoon sunlight streaming through high clerestory windows — this is the iconic Japanese school gymnasium.
Sakura Heights Gymnasium is Pack 4 of the Sakura Heights Japanese High School series: a 120-asset modular kit delivering a complete, fully closed 24 x 40 m main sports hall and an integrated 8 x 28 m support wing assembled from 350 structural and interior meshes. Designed for sports anime creators, visual novel developers, and game environments, it seamlessly supports volleyball matches, basketball tournaments, school entrance/graduation ceremonies, and cultural festival performances.
FIVE DEDICATED GYMNASIUM DEPARTMENTS (120 UNIQUE ASSETS)

  - Architecture & Heavy Structural Shell (26 assets): 4 m modular exterior gym walls (8 m tall), high clerestory window banks, entrance double doors, heavy structural steel ceiling trusses (8 m clear clearance), timber court floor modules with regulation lines, 60 main hall roof modules, 14 annex roof modules, drainage gutters, and ventilation stacks.

  - Sports & Court Competition Equipment (36 assets): Tournament-grade volleyball net with padded uprights, elevated referee stand, rolling ball cart trolley, volleyballs, basketball hoops with glass backboards, badminton net posts, folding table tennis table, digital electronic LED scoreboard, manual flip-card scorekeeper, team sideline benches, and umpire chair.

  - Equipment Storage & Changing Facilities (18 assets): Heavy wire-mesh equipment security cage, classic multi-tier wooden vaulting box (tobi-bako), thick high-jump foam landing mats, gymnastics balance beam, medicine ball rack, jumping ropes, metal changing lockers, wooden bench seating, wall coat racks, and shoe cubbies.

  - Ceremony Stage & Event Production (16 assets): Elevated wooden ceremonial stage (0.9 m high), red velvet stage curtain, ceremonial speaker's podium, gold-framed school crest emblem, rows of folding metal assembly chairs, folding stage access steps, adjustable stage spotlights, and microphone stand.

  - Story & Narrative Vignettes (24 assets): School championship banner wall (National Tournament 1998), student club water bottles, sports duffel bags, forgotten kneepads, wide floor sweat mops, first-aid ice packs, megaphone, digital stopwatch, and referee whistle on a lanyard.

THE SHARED 4 M ARCHITECTURAL MODULE CONTRACTThis building is engineered to snap directly into the rest of the campus:

  - Structural Grid: Exactly 4 m (matches Classrooms, Specialist, Faculty, and Grounds).

  - Main Hall Dimensions: 24 x 40 m footprint with 8.0 m clear ceiling height beneath trusses.

  - Support Wing Dimensions: 8 x 28 m annexed wing for storage and changing rooms.

  - Stage Height: 0.9 m datum.

  - Snaps natively into the 660-asset Sakura Heights Academy master campus bundle.

ENGINE-READY THREE-MATERIAL SYSTEMThree clean materials provide lightweight performance and global lighting control:

  - M_Pack_Atlas: One single 2048x2048 PBR texture atlas covering all court timber, concrete, steel trusses, sports equipment, mats, velvet curtains, and props.

  - M_Glass: High clerestory windows, exterior double doors, and clear basketball backboards.

  - M_Emissive_Score: Vibrant digital LED scoreboard numbers, emergency exit signs, and stage spots.

PRE-TESTED EXPORT PIPELINE

  - Base-centered pivots: Center X = 0, Center Y = 0, Minimum Z = 0 on every individual model.

  - 120 individual FBX files, all independently re-imported and topology-verified.

  - 120 individual OBJ files with matched MTL files and self-contained atlas texture copy.

  - 1 combined origin-correct GLB containing the complete 350-mesh assembled gymnasium building.

  - Clean Blender master scene with realistic dusk court lighting, spotlights, and camera angles.

DOWNLOAD CONTENTS

  - Clean Sakura_Heights_Gymnasium.blend master scene with all 350 assembled meshes, camera, and lighting rig.

  - 120 individual FBX files, all re-import tested.

  - 120 OBJ files with 120 companion MTL files and atlas texture copy.

  - 1 combined glTF 2.0 GLB master gymnasium building assembly.

  - 2048x2048 PBR color texture atlas PNG + labeled UV layout PNG.

  - 14 HD 1920x1080 Cycles marketing stills including full exterior, court interiors, entrance ceremony, and wireframe topology proofs.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

  - 120 unique assets (350 meshes in assembled master building)

  - 461,084 triangles total (3,842 average triangles per asset — rich court and equipment detail)

  - 246,932 vertices, 254,161 faces / polygons

  - Largest asset: Wall_High_Window_Bank at 18,240 tris

  - Smallest asset: Whistle at 40 tris

  - 3 clean materials: M_Pack_Atlas, M_Glass, M_Emissive_Score

  - Single active UV channel per textured model (clean atlas palette mapping)

  - Real-world metric scale on 4 m modular grid

  - Supported formats: BLEND, FBX, OBJ/MTL, GLB

Ideal for sports anime games (volleyball, basketball), visual novels, manga backgrounds, martial arts tournaments, school ceremony events, VRChat community halls, VTuber streaming, Roblox school roleplay, and stylized animations.

description_text:
This Female Crew Neck Worn Orange is a high end, photorealistic 3D model, that will help you to add realism to your project. The model is suitable for any visual production - broadcast, high-res film close-ups, advertising, games, design visualisation, forensic presentation, etc.

The model was initially created in 3Ds Max 2012, then fully textured and rendered using V-Ray.

All geometry and visual aspects of the model are optimised to give you the highest possible quality for up to 2k renders. There is no post-production used on any of the renders you see.

Features:

    -This model is accurately sized to match the real object.
   -Objects are grouped and named according to their real purpose, allowing the model to be rigged and animated smoothly.
  -Clean and optimised topology is used for maximum polygon efficiency.
   -Model is fully sub-dividable to allow Turbosmooth Iterations to increase mesh smoothness if needed.
    -All textures and materials are tailored and applied for high-quality render results.
   -All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.
  -No extra plugins are required for this model.
  -Lights and cameras are not included in the scenes.

Technical Specifications:

-Model is included in 4 file formats.
                -3ds Max V-Ray
                -3ds Max Mental ray
                -Cinema 4D R17 V-Ray
                -OBJ

  -Model consists of quads only.
  -Model Dimensions: 50.4788cm x 27.8958cm x 58.0709cm
